name: Inverse Transform Sampling with Piecewise Linear Density
definition: A differentiable sampling method that generates samples from a distribution induced by piecewise linear interpolation of density $\sigma_r$, ensuring samples follow the Beer-Lambert law within each bin.
summary: Inverse Transform Sampling with Piecewise Linear Density is a differentiable method that interpolates density directly to ensure samples follow the Beer-Lambert law, offering better numerical stability than NeRF's exponentiated density approach.
